name: Transfer funds between two of a member's own accounts
goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Transfer Funds'. The From Account and To Account fields are dropdowns whose options are account numbers; select exactly the given from_account and to_account values by their account number, not by guessing a product name. Fill in the amount and post the transfer. Read back the confirmation reference after posting. This action is irreversible once posted.

inputs.name: from_account
inputs.description: Account number to transfer from, exactly as shown in the From Account dropdown.

inputs.name: to_account
inputs.description: Account number to transfer to, exactly as shown in the To Account dropdown.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist.
The source account does not have enough available balance.
The transfer form rejected the submitted values.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
